plugin_identity.title: Identity sources
plugin_identity.description: Per-tenant LDAP/AD login and CAS single sign-on. LDAP is tried after a local password fails; CAS uses its own entry link.
plugin_identity.testLoginHint: Runs a real directory search and password check with a real account. It only shows the mapped result: no user is created and nobody is signed in. The password is not stored.
plugin_identity.copyFailed: Copy failed, please copy it manually
plugin_identity.entryLdap: Account and password on the login page

fields.name: Name
fields.requireMappedGroup: Require a mapped group on every sign-in

hints.url: ldap:// or ldaps://, optional port. The server certificate is verified by default.
hints.startTls: ldap:// only: upgrades the connection to TLS. If the upgrade fails the sign-in fails; it never falls back to plaintext.
hints.allowPlaintext: With ldap:// and no StartTLS, the service account password and user passwords cross the network in cleartext. Only enable this when the directory has no TLS at all; saving the source and every sign-in log a warning.
hints.bindDn: Service account used to look users up. Leave empty for anonymous search.
hints.bindPassword: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
hints.bindPasswordKeep: Already set. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
hints.userFilter: Must contain {username}; the login name is escaped before substitution, e.g. (&(objectClass=person)(uid={username})).
hints.serverUrl: For example https://cas.example.com/cas. Tickets are checked with serviceValidate.
hints.serviceBaseUrl: For example https://admin.example.com. The callback URL is built from this, never from request headers; the entry link uses it too.
hints.casUsername: CAS 3.0 attribute name. Leave empty to use the CAS principal (cas:user).
hints.attrGroups: Attribute containing external groups. Leave empty for memberOf in LDAP/AD or groups in CAS.
hints.groupRoleMappings: Enter the full group name or DN exactly as returned by the directory. Matching is case- and whitespace-sensitive; nested groups are not expanded. Roles are granted only when a user is auto-created. Matches use mapped roles; otherwise the default role applies. Existing users' local roles are never overwritten.
hints.roleCodes: Enter one role code per line. A group can grant multiple roles; no JSON is needed.
hints.requireMappedGroup: When enabled, every sign-in through this source must match at least one group mapping, including sign-ins by existing users. This switch does not synchronize or overwrite local roles.
hints.caCert: Optional. When set, only this CA is trusted. There is no option to skip certificate checks.
hints.matchExisting: Bind the directory account to an existing user with the same name (super admins are never matched).
hints.autoCreate: Create the user when none matches. Subject to the tenant user quota; no local password. Off by default.
hints.defaultRole: Role code granted to auto-created users. Leave empty for the system default low-privilege role.
hints.defaultRoleOff: Only used when auto-create is on.

sync.title: Directory sync
sync.explanation: Manually copy directory accounts into local users (create or update). Local roles are never changed and nothing runs on a schedule.
sync.filterHint: Used for enumeration only; it must not contain {username} and is independent of the user filter above.
sync.filterError: The sync filter is required and must not contain {username}
sync.subjectHint: entryUUID (OpenLDAP) or objectGUID (AD): single-valued and unique per account; sync uses it to tell whether two entries are the same account.
sync.deactivateMissing: Deactivate accounts missing from the directory
sync.deactivateHint: Off by default. Only after a complete enumeration and a fully successful write does sync deactivate accounts bound to this source that were not returned this time. It aborts when the directory returns fewer than half of the bound accounts, never touches super admins or users holding built-in roles, and never re-activates an account automatically.
sync.disabled: This source is disabled or has directory sync turned off, so it cannot start a sync.
sync.loadError: Failed to read the sync status
sync.pollLimit: Automatic refresh stopped; refresh manually to see the result

errors.attribute: Attribute names must start with a letter, contain only letters, digits or hyphens, and be at most 64 characters
errors.mappingGroup: Enter a group name or DN (at most 2048 bytes, no control characters)
errors.mappingRole: Enter 1–100 unique role codes per group, one per line; each at most 64 bytes, with no surrounding whitespace or control characters. super is forbidden
errors.mappingCount: At most 100 group mappings are allowed
errors.mappingTotal: At most 1000 role codes are allowed across all mappings
errors.mappingDuplicate: Group names or DNs must be unique
errors.mappingRequired: Add at least one group mapping to enable the sign-in restriction
errors.ldapUrl: Must start with ldap:// or ldaps:// and have no path
errors.plaintextRequired: ldap:// without StartTLS sends passwords in cleartext. Use ldaps://, enable StartTLS, or confirm cleartext transfer
